input: Find nature, outdoor adventure, farm, horseback riding and fishing summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Weaverville, Woodfin, Leicester, Candler, Barnardsville, Marshall, Mars Hill and Hot Springs, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Weaverville Woodfin nature outdoor summer camp 2026
Earth Path Education summer camps 2026 NC
Forest Floor Wilderness summer camps Alexander Woodfin 2026

candidates.name: Sunny Truth Nature Programs LLC
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camps for ages 5–12 with farm animals, nature exploration, games, art and science.

candidates.name: Madison County Community Learning Centers
candidates.note: 2025–2026 camps include wilderness survival, farm-to-table cooking, nature science and outdoor theater.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Madison County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun offers creek ecology, horseback riding, animal science, cooking and sewing for ages 5–18.

candidates.name: Full Moon Equestrian
candidates.note: June 2025 day camp for ages 6+ covering riding, horse care, groundwork, barn chores and crafts.

candidates.name: Pegasus Hill Farm
candidates.note: 2026 horse camps for ages 6+, 9am–1pm, with riding, groundwork, horse care, games and crafts.

candidates.name: Young Life — Windy Gap
candidates.note: Residential youth summer camp and Pioneer Plunge adventure trips; verified 2026 high-school sessions.

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: Camp Farmstead offered six themed, weeklong farm-and-forest day-camp sessions in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Earth Path Education
candidates.note: Announced Nature Sisters Day Camp for girls ages 8–11, August 2–6, 2027, at Kingfisher Waters.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong nature-connection and wilderness-skills camps; locations include Haw Creek Commons and Shope Creek.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 outdoor garden camps for ages 6–10 and CIT ages 11–16; gardening, cooking, animals and nature activities.
